rust_summary: querying the current inventory screen's slot rectangles (`native_screen_slot_rects`).
doc_summary: `NativeScreenView.kind` identifies specific vanilla screens or menu types when known; ambiguous and mod screens have no kind. `screen_slot_rects()` returns the open inventory or creative screen's `(slot_id, [x, y, width, height])` entries in GUI pixels, or `None` when no known vanilla slot screen is visible. The IDs are game inventory slot IDs, not necessarily network menu indices. Bundles need fragment @API:screen_slot_rects@.
